//: Live demo config. Same rubric as every other team; only source modes differ from teams/demo.json. Tracker is a real Jira project seeded with synthetic tickets. Metrics and warehouse are off until Grafana Cloud and Databricks are provisioned, and the report will say so rather than inventing numbers.

tracker.name: Demo app
tracker.//component_model: This team-managed project has no components configured. Components are carried as labels of the form component-<name>. Treat a component-* label as the component when scoping history and duplicate search, so the counts stay area-scoped rather than project-wide.

metrics.//: Grafana Cloud not provisioned yet. Absent metrics lowers confidence and removes the regression escalation; it never raises severity.

warehouse.//: Warehouse not provisioned yet, Neon planned. Blast radius will be reported as unknown.

code.//: No code-search MCP is bound in this session. The demo repo github.com/NjAIAgents/njagents-demo-app can be read directly, but that is not a source binding, so the code envelope is unavailable and the error-swallowing escalation cannot fire.

release_correlation.//: The demo repo carries real tags 2026.08 and 2026.09 with backdated commits, but no version-control MCP is bound, so vcs_tag cannot run. fixtures/releases.json records the same two releases. Switch manifest_sources to vcs_tag once a version-control MCP is connected.

output.//run_trace: Safe to publish here because every ticket in DEMO is synthetic. A team whose tracker holds real customer tickets should leave this at the 'file' default.
